input.quote: 4.1 Term; Termination. This Agreement shall be effective as of that date (the \"Effective Date\") the Site becomes fully operational as set forth in writing and executed by both Parties and shall continue for a period of one (1) year from the Effective Date.
input.rationale: Section 4 addresses term, termination notice and the Termination Payment but says nothing about what happens to our data or our migration to another host on exit; Sections 1.4/1.5 only cover in-term access and export files, and Section 8 confidentiality does not require return or export of Content, user information or other Company data. HDI hosts the Site and holds our Content and user data, so the absence of any exit mechanic is a deviation. We insert a single new Section 4.3 at the fallback level: at least 90 days of transition assistance and export of our data within 30 days of expiry or termination. Preferred extras (six months at then-current rates, machine-readable format, certified deletion) are noted as a fallback trade in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert Section 4.3 requiring 90 days of transition assistance and export of Company data within 30 days of expiry or termination.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no exit provisions, so we added a short Section 4.3 giving us at least 90 days of transition assistance and export of our Content, user information and other data within 30 days of expiry or termination. This is our fallback position; our preferred position is six months of assistance at HDI's then-current rates with certified deletion after return.

ops.text: Transition Assistance; Return of Data. Upon the expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide transition assistance to the Company for a period of at least ninety (90) days; and (b) within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, export and deliver to the Company all Content, user information and other data of the Company in HDI's possession or control.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
